east_catalysts_risks.notes: Few in-window items could be verified. The only fetched in-window source is the Construction World Blue Line trial piece (28 Oct). The Hindu Old Madras Road article was blocked. The Trade Brains (Blackstone, Phase 4), Goodreturns, Urban Acres Panathur and Bengaluru Live Kasavanahalli articles did not surface in search, so I made no claims from them. Search summaries indicated the Blackstone deal was first reported around 13 Oct (Hindustan Times/Propstack) at Prestige Lakeshore Drive, so the 28 Oct Trade Brains piece is likely a re-run. I found no in-window news on STRR, PRR/BBC, suburban rail, Cauvery supply, lake flooding or the Sarjapur-Hebbal approval. The last report I saw said BMRCL expected central approval for Sarjapur-Hebbal by October, but I found no confirmation. I did not confirm that the Blue Line trials actually began. The claims above, apart from the 28 Oct trial and timeline items, are background. I did not open BMRCL or K-RIDE pages. The fetch tool did not reach thehindu.com.

east_launches_prices.notes: No project launch or new phase in East Bengaluru dated inside 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-29 06:00 IST was found in 14 searches and 6 fetch attempts. Search results were dominated by aggregator and listing pages with unreliable dates. The leads dated 27-28 Oct (Trade Brains and Goodreturns Phase 4, Construction World trials, Urban Acres Panathur, Bengaluru Live Kasavanahalli) could not be located, so nothing from them is reported. The Hindu lead could not be fetched. Claims above are all pre-window background. Unverified candidates seen only on aggregators: Purva Gunjur Rise (Puravankara, about 5 acres, about 350 homes, late-2026 launch, May 2026 review), Brigade Gunjur (8.63 acres, upcoming), Sattva Aangane (Budigere Cross, pre-launch), Godrej Woodland (Sarjapur Road, pre-launch plots). No RERA numbers were seen on the RERA portal. Check these directly in a later run.

government_watch.notes: Thin window. WebFetch is blocked on thehindu.com and returned HTTP 403 for Deccan Herald and Business Standard, so those leads are only confirmed by search snippets and are not reported as claims. TOI leads (Pink Line crossing 100 km, land acquisition for private wealth, GBA road plans through lakes/forests/Lalbagh/defence land) and the Bangalore Mirror, Bengaluru Live (Kasavanahalli LED) and Urban Acres (lake buffer draft) pieces were not retrievable. Searches turned up no in-window primary government release on cabinet decisions, RERA orders, stamp duty or guidance value, BWSSB, KIADB, K-RIDE or tunnel-road tender. The lake buffer and drain buffer rules look like 2025 drafts and the Bill's status is conflicting, so they are left out. Pink Line status conflicts between sources: one text says CMRS authorisation is pending, while the later update and Urban Acres say clearance has been received. The 15 November inauguration is reported as likely or proposed, not confirmed. Mahindra figures come from a developer-sourced release carried by a wire-distribution site. No Mahindra official page was opened.

metro_watch.notes: Thin, headline-level evidence. Deccan Herald and The Hindu blocked fetches and the search tool rejected TOI, Hindu and others, so in-window claims rest on lead or search-result headlines (headline text used as excerpt), not article bodies. Search summaries, which I could not verify against the articles, say CM D K Shivakumar said PM Modi is likely to inaugurate the elevated Pink Line when he visits on November 15, that CMRS authorisation came on about 28–29 October, that Nov 3 (Pune Metro Line 3 event) was also floated, and that Minister Krishna Byre Gowda said the line is ready once the Centre gives a date. Treat all of that as unconfirmed until an article body is read. Other DH headlines seen without dates: 'CM Shivakumar seeks date from PM to open elevated Pink Line; CMRS flags observations', 'Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line faces 36 safety and technical deficiencies', 'Pink Line: BMRCL files compliance with CMRS's observations'. Nothing in-window found on Blue Line, Phase 3, Red Line, Yellow Line, K-RIDE, fares or ridership. bmrc.co.in and kride.in showed no dated in-window news. Network length 96.10 km rising to 103.60 km comes from OneIndia (9 Oct).

north_south_west.notes: No residential launches (villa, plot or apartment) dated within 26–29 Oct 2026 were found for the north, south or west corridors. Search returned only undated or stale listing pages, so none are reported. The Hindu is blocked to WebFetch, so the Pink Line 15 November inauguration lead (CM statement, 28 Oct) is unverified. The Asianet 28 Oct piece says the opening date is not yet fixed. Lead articles on Devanahalli farmers' protest, the Hennur–Bagalur signal-free plan and Krishna Byre Gowda's directive, Anekal/GBA election uncertainty, and the Phase 4 corridor lists were not retrievable. Searches only surfaced older background (2025 Devanahalli KIADB protest; Hennur–Bagalur white-topping delays reported by Deccan Herald in 2025). Deccan Herald returned 403. The Yelahanka Palace item is a family property dispute with no market relevance. The Hebbal SC story: Deccan Herald (via search snippet only) reports the exact deposit as Rs 20,31,74,125 and says BMRCL told the court the corridor is about 84% complete, targeting June 2027 opening. I could not open that page, so it is not reported as a claim.

social_signals.notes: No social-media content from the window could be found or verified, so no claims are reported. Reddit refused fetches. LinkedIn returned 403 (login wall). YouTube's search page returned only footer text. Twelve searches, including site:youtube.com and site:linkedin.com variants, returned no results from those platforms. They returned developer blogs (Sobha, Brigade, Godrej, NBR, Sattva), portals and brokers, none dated 26–29 Oct 2026. The only possibly relevant items were out of window or stale, so I did not report them. Arvind SmartSpaces' Nagondanahalli, Whitefield launch is dated 10 Mar 2026. Aug 2026 reports said the Blue Line was unlikely to open commercially in 2026. The Oct 2026 Blue Line ORR trial run was only a target, with no confirmation found. Developer blogs' appreciation and price figures are promotional and unverified. This is a valid 'nothing found' result and not evidence that nothing was posted. Social platforms were largely inaccessible to logged-out tooling.
